g.title: RoatheRank3Convo4 begins.
g.text: RoatheRank3Convo4 begins.

g.title: j3079958993
g.text: Can you answer a question for me, Usurper? It has been troubling me for some time.

g.title: j3480859799
g.text: Ask away.

g.title: j1985159996
g.text: What could possibly be troubling you?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j2060033152
g.text: Why are you doing all this?

g.title: j4268133797
g.text: I could rattle off the list, but I fear we would be here all afternoon. No, my line of questioning in this regard is over one particular topic specifically. Today, at least.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3524964328
g.text: Check boolean RoatheKnowsReset2

g.title: j730648262
g.text: And I am not speaking about you meddling with my memories. I mean "all this" in a broader sense.

g.title: j3524964328->j730648262
g.text: true

g.title: j2768280751
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j3524964328->j2768280751
g.text: false

g.title: j2366806945
g.text: You seem to be set upon running about this universe behind Albrecht with a mop bucket. Look at your work with his butler.

g.title: j2768280751->j2366806945
g.text: true

g.title: j1427703360
g.text: You seem to be set upon running about this universe behind Albrecht with a mop bucket.

g.title: j2768280751->j1427703360
g.text: false

g.title: j2476974658
g.text: Check boolean IsDating

g.title: j2237923516
g.text: It does seem that you have your own itches to scratch in the meanwhile - and I applaud you for it, I am hardly judging you. It just strikes me as odd that someone so otherwise... wondrously and wildly malapert would be so otherwise obedient.

g.title: j2476974658->j2237923516
g.text: true

g.title: j3385737729
g.text: It just strikes me as odd that someone so otherwise... wondrously and wildly malapert would be so otherwise obedient.

g.title: j2476974658->j3385737729
g.text: false

g.title: j2612474835
g.text: Letting the Indifference destroy the Origin System - or anywhere else - doesn't help anyone.

g.title: j1222004160
g.text: I don't obey Entrati.

g.title: j880795050
g.text: I have my own reasons. And they're mine to keep.

g.title: j2726807290
g.text: Ah, I see. Simply a temporary service you are providing until the situation with "the Indifference" is dealt with. And what do you plan to do then?

g.title: j3737515931
g.text: Truly? It seems that from where I sit. He snaps his fingers and you heel and sit at his ankles like a trained kubrow. He even whispers the name "Tau" and you lot scramble to recall every possible detail of the place that you have lost.

g.title: j555311203
g.text: So mysterious, so inscrutable! And such a load of drover shit. If you do not simply wish to admit the fact that you are at his beck and call, so be it.

g.title: j144454476
g.text: Why are you picking at this? What are you really trying to ask me?

g.title: j2184413605
g.text: I haven't really thought that far in advance, to be honest.

g.title: j219127578
g.text: I intend to make him pay for making such a mess. He has a lot to atone for.

g.title: j1087863904
g.text: Assuming I survive, you mean?

g.title: j1576211743
g.text: Go where I'm needed, like I always do. Problems tend to find me.

g.title: j2119718713
g.text: Why are you trying so hard to make me angry?

g.title: j3767633041
g.text: I'm just doing what I have to do to help people get out of the miserable situations they're in.

g.title: j818868700
g.text: Because from where I sit, it seems he snaps his fingers and you heel and sit at his ankles like a trained kubrow. He even whispers the name "Tau" and you lot scramble to recall every possible detail of the place that you have lost.

g.title: j543693742
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2091862032
g.text: Ah! So you admit you are an idiot! How refreshing. I adore when fools place their lack of wit right out in the open, it makes my task of manipulating them all the easier.

g.title: j2738382914
g.text: Ah! So it is base, primal revenge you are after! Glorious. A rabid animal, ready to gnaw at the bones of those who have wronged you.

g.title: j1515979909
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j326538833
g.text: Ah, I see. Listlessness masked with nobility. You do not know where you belong, where you should stay, so you cloak yourself in this veneer of "righteousness sacrifice" and do the bidding of others?

g.title: j4224198963
g.text: Because I cannot for the life of me fathom why you, an entity that has, as near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely, is set upon running amok through time and space, "Playing Therapist."

g.title: j1062752126
g.text: Yes, which gets to the meat of it! Why do you insist on wandering about time and space "Playing Therapist?" You, who are an entity that has, near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely,

g.title: j2230882139
g.text: Astute. Yes, very well, I will get to the heart of what I am asking more directly. I was attempting to goad you into anger to see if it would prompt a more honest response.

g.title: j317747760
g.text: You are like a kubrow who has finally caught a kaithe. You do not know what to do now you have your teeth in its leg.

g.title: j3517756341
g.text: One of the simplest and oldest of all human motivations. And, therefore, one of the easiest to understand.

g.title: j4062048589
g.text: Never officially a soldier, yet in your tone I hear the weariness of the most battle-hardened of them all.

g.title: j704188706
g.text: How utterly tragic.

g.title: j2198213082
g.text: If I were you, I would be back in Duviri attempting to discover what other holes in the fabric of the Void I could punch through! Imagine the possibilities! Imagine the worlds, ripe for the taking!

g.title: j2111191279
g.text: But I suppose this will have to do.

g.title: j2391371095
g.text: Very well. From one to another, out of respect, I will get to the heart of what I am asking more directly. I was attempting to goad you into anger to see if it would prompt a more honest response.

g.title: j2633062991
g.text: I have a place where I belong.

g.title: j1084660117
g.text: You don't know what you're talking about.

g.title: j2956372558
g.text: You're no different than Albrecht. He's going through time causing all these problems. And you want to do that to whole dimensions?!

g.title: j1968352193
g.text: That's the problem with you Orokin. You think whole worlds are just yours to do with as you please.

g.title: j4243832880
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j375984319
g.text: Do tell! Is it this Höllvania? Or perhaps Duviri? Or perhaps your crashed Orbiter on what remains of Earth?

g.title: j1310123581
g.text: Then tell me all about where your home is! Is it this Höllvania? Or perhaps Duviri? Or perhaps your crashed Orbiter on what remains of Earth?

g.title: j3435554402
g.text: And why shouldn't we? We are the superior creations, are we not? Albrecht is doing as he likes, and you have no problem going around cleaning up after him! Why shouldn't I have the right to do the same? What makes his quest "justified" and mine not?

g.title: j784482727
g.text: And why shouldn't we? We are the superior creations, are we not? Albrecht is doing as he likes, rampaging through time, infecting mass populi with a disease he barely understands, all in the name of "defeating a so-called god."

g.title: j2153499613
g.text: I cannot for the life of me fathom why you, an entity that has, as near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely, is set upon running amok through time and space, "Playing Therapist."

g.title: j1502260832
g.text: But look at you!

g.title: j3956801596
g.text: Check boolean IsDating

g.title: j965779903
g.text: Check boolean IsDating

g.title: j3071398740
g.text: You, who has powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships. (And collecting a few of your own.)

g.title: j3956801596->j3071398740
g.text: true

g.title: j426217235
g.text: You, who has powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships.

g.title: j3956801596->j426217235
g.text: false

g.title: j1424101110
g.text: You, who has powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships. (And collecting a few of your own.)

g.title: j965779903->j1424101110
g.text: true

g.title: j2316267621
g.text: You, who has powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships.

g.title: j965779903->j2316267621
g.text: false

g.title: j413725523
g.text: I am simply flabbergasted. I cannot comprehend it. Why? Why, when by all rights you could be ruling some universe somewhere?

g.title: j2156662169
g.text: I am simply flabbergasted. I cannot comprehend it. Why? Why, when by all rights you could be ruling some universe somewhere?

g.title: j2799741766
g.text: I'm happy what I'm doing. I'm helping people the way I want to be helping people.

g.title: j3857792203
g.text: I'm not sure if you can wrap your head around this, but try: I don't want to rule a universe.

g.title: j2077803501
g.text: It would make me no better than Albrecht. Or the Orokin. Rampaging around remaking the world in my image. I'm not interested in that.

g.title: j2690424406
g.text: I'm happy what I'm doing. I'm helping people the way I want to be helping people.

g.title: j101088501
g.text: I'm not sure if you can wrap your head around this, but try: I don't want to rule a universe.

g.title: j2793052452
g.text: It would make me no better than Albrecht. Or the Orokin. Rampaging around remaking the world in my image. I'm not interested in that.

g.title: j710659438
g.text: But why? That is what I do not understand.

g.title: j4104706583
g.text: So you would rather be... what? Small?

g.title: j2243899525
g.text: So you would rather be... what? Small?

g.title: j1990388149
g.text: Check boolean RoatheUnloved1

g.title: j1009575429
g.text: If you think it's small to do what I do, sure. That's your opinion. What I've done has rewritten history.

g.title: j2286598494
g.text: Not small. Unseen. Let everyone run around drawing attention. I'll stay in the shadows.

g.title: j2662778255
g.text: Because helping people when they need it is how we are going to get out of this mess in the end.

g.title: j1990388149->j2662778255
g.text: true

g.title: j1990388149->j2662778255
g.text: false

g.title: j35733642
g.text: Because I'm doing what needs to be done. Nothing more, nothing less.

g.title: j1990388149->j35733642
g.text: true

g.title: j1990388149->j35733642
g.text: false

g.title: j3742215901
g.text: You said you've never know what it's like to be loved. I don't think you'll understand how powerful it can be in changing how the world around you can work.

g.title: j1990388149->j3742215901
g.text: true

g.title: j1522250006
g.text: Have you ever been in love, Roathe? Or cared about someone so strongly you would burn the universe down for them?

g.title: j1990388149->j1522250006
g.text: false

g.title: j2646242866
g.text: That is precisely my point! Let us go and rewrite history, then! Not sit about here trying to convince everyone to hold hand and sing songs!

g.title: j3691193493
g.text: Ah, I see, you prefer to be the quiet assassin in the shadows is it? Strike when you are least suspected? No. I do not think so. I think you are simply spinning your wheels.

g.title: j4207021866
g.text: Mmhm. Running errands for strangers until they worship you like some local hero? Or convincing them all to hold hands and sing songs? Pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.

g.title: j2057512446
g.text: And what you are "doing" seems to be running about convincing everyone to hold hands and sing songs in between bouts of incredible shows of violence. The violence makes sense. The rest is nauseating.

g.title: j504944158
g.text: If you are going to insist that we are going to save the universe from this "Indifference" by holding hands and singing songs pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.

g.title: j3596629498
g.text: Boolean RoatheUnloved1 is now true.

g.title: j2517443128
g.text: Be patient. We have to deal with the Indifference, first.

g.title: j981097357
g.text: Maybe, once all of this has blown over. But not right now.

g.title: j1364538243
g.text: And you think I'd choose you to do it with? Don't make me laugh.

g.title: j2561990108
g.text: You know not what you do or why you do it, you are simply doing what you are told. Another self-important henchmen of a self-important Orokin. Shame.

g.title: j1527117970
g.text: I'm just saying that you seem to be really mad about the idea of people no longer being miserable. And you seem to be taking that very personally.

g.title: j4275250758
g.text: The point I was trying to make was simply that if "the Indifference" feeds off a lack of emotions, having them might be the key to defeating it.

g.title: j1904130257
g.text: Do you think it's impossible for someone to love you? Or do you think you're not capable of feeling love for someone else? Or do you think it just hasn't happened yet?

g.title: j3422837773
g.text: No, I have not. And if you are going to insist that we are going to save the universe from this "Indifference" by holding hands and singing songs pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.

g.title: j4000286353
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2852873956
g.text: Fine. Fine! I will bide my time, as you say. Play these... foolish games.

g.title: j3647458483
g.text: Boolean RoatheInsulted is now true.

g.title: j3068765525
g.text: Because misery loves company? Perhaps. Or, because I am simply confused that you are running about wasting your time when there is real work that we could be doing.

g.title: j596415324
g.text: More proof that this thing is a figment of your imagination! What kind of real god or "anti-god" would ever be defeated by the "kindness of human emotions!" Ha!

g.title: j3912191335
g.text: Boolean RoatheUnloved2 is now true.

g.title: j428498859
g.text: I suppose we still have work to do, as you say. I simply cannot fathom such... childish things have purpose to them. But, then again, here I sit on this end of things, and you are the one with keys to the universe.

g.title: j2324584365
g.text: Fair point. Why would you ever pick someone so detestable as the Devil of Tau?

g.title: j1051360424
g.text: But now I am convinced you know not what you do or why you do it, and that you are simply doing what you are told. Another self-important henchmen of a self-important Orokin. Shame.

g.title: j1956249368
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3872137862
g.text: Stop speaking about subjects of which you know absolutely nothing, Drifter.

g.title: j2858906708
g.text: Until then I shall merely go back to annoying the floating botfly.

g.title: j3099074835
g.text: Really the more you tell me about these insane theories of yours the more you convince me that I am right. You all have built a strawman of your own insanity and this thing is just feeding off your own insecurities.

g.title: j367054140
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3705297791
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j292854530
g.text: If you all simply shut your eyes long enough and ignored it, I guarantee it would go away on its own.

g.title: j2377991688
g.text: It at least passes the time.

g.title: j224997397
g.text: Boolean RoatheMITW4 is now true.
